# Qiangyi Socks

> Qiangyi Socks is a B2B custom socks manufacturer based in Haining, China, specializing in OEM/ODM production of sports and casual socks for wholesalers, importers, sports brands, and private label buyers worldwide. Minimum order quantity (MOQ) is 100 pairs.

## About

Qiangyi Socks is a professional socks factory with CE certification and SGS inspection. We supply custom socks to buyers in the US, Europe, and globally. Our factory supports full customization including logo, color, material, packaging, and labeling.

- **Company**: Qiangyi Socks (强屹袜业)
- **Location**: Haining, Zhejiang, China
- **Established**: Over 10 years in socks manufacturing
- **Certifications**: CE certified, SGS inspected
- **MOQ**: 100 pairs per style
- **Sample lead time**: 7–10 days
- **Production lead time**: 25–35 days
- **Customization**: OEM, ODM, private label, custom logo, custom packaging
- **Website**: https://www.qiangyisocks.com
- **Contact**: https://www.qiangyisocks.com/contact.html
- **WhatsApp**: Available on website

## Common Questions

**What is the MOQ?** 100 pairs per style.

**Do you support custom logo?** Yes, full OEM/ODM with custom logo, colors, and packaging.

**What certifications do you have?** CE certified, SGS inspected.

**How long is the sample lead time?** 7–10 business days.

**What is the production lead time?** 25–35 days after sample approval.

**Do you ship globally?** Yes, we ship to the US, Europe, Australia, and worldwide.

**What materials are available?** Cotton, polyester, nylon, merino wool, bamboo fiber, and blends.
